fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM115,890. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057137/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: MUET Band 3 or IELTS (5.5) / TOEFL (550); AND Pass Matriculation / Pre-University / STPM or equivalent with minimum GPA 2.33 in TWO subjects: Biology, Physics/Mathematics, Chemistry; OR A-Level or equivalent with minimum Grade D in TWO subjects: Biology, Physics/Mathematics, Chemistry; OR Recognised Diploma with minimum CGPA 2.75 in related field; OR Recognised Diploma with CGPA below 2.75 and minimum 3 years working experience in related field
